retention.finding: Signed E8-1 option A resolves the `usage.event` history binding: select the existing `ai.usage.usage-retention` setting under SP-341/UF-108, not a fixed ordinary-telemetry policy. The setting remains 90 days by default with its existing allowed choices. For each Project or application entry, `retention_binding.setting_key = ai.usage.usage-retention`, `retention_binding.anchor = first_durable_save`: the first successful save of that exact entry that survives a restart supplies the immutable anchor. Retry, replay, reprocessing, compaction, backup restore and later settlement/correction of the entry never reset that anchor; a genuinely separate entry has its own first-save anchor. Read the configured window and apply it from that preserved anchor in both seglog and Parquet; unlimited means no age expiry. If the original anchor or setting cannot be authenticated, refuse expiry rather than substitute occurrence, observation, source-result, run-finish or recovery time. There is no count eviction. Daily account/provider/model totals remain canonical, backed up and permanent; commit their accounting before detail cleanup and never rebuild them from expired detail. Holds, required references, recovery, rollback and protected backups still block deletion. This is the existing setting-driven policy selector, not a newly minted policy ID. The separate original source rows keep their exact DL-507 assignments; no source-row lifetime is transferred from this event answer. `PENDING_RETENTION_BINDING` is resolved for this event; separate admission, storage implementation and native proof remain required.
